decisions.reason: As a flagship citrus harvesting crate with unresolved market potential and low carrying cost relative to its option value, keep.
As a core foldable large container line that maintained its own website page, keep because its option value remains high and carrying costs are low.
As a standard stackable plastic crate serving broad customer segments, keep because its option value is likely still positive and keeping costs are low.
As a medium-duty rackable pallet with an established market role but many alternatives, keep with moderate drop risk given the firm's many options.
The spill-retention pallet's downgrade from its own page to a mere mention by 2019 signals the option has resolved unfavourably, and the firm has many other options.
The plastic pallet with load retainers lost its own page by 2019 and is a niche option among many, indicating its value is unlikely to be realized.
